title: fix: keep the confirmed dashboard session when a refresh fails
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix: a dashboard session refresh that fails to complete (network error or failed get-session) reuses the last confirmed session instead of replacing the dashboard, and an open new-key secret, with an error page.
- An expired session resolves with no user, not an error, so sign-out is unaffected. With no confirmed session yet, the failure still shows the error page.
- Minimal version of #15422 by @gggff123 (credited as co-author): one file, no new resolver module. The unrelated agent `model` output in that PR belongs to #15382.

Fixes #15401

gist.headline: A refresh without a reset
gist.blurb: A flaky session check no longer sends the dashboard packing. Even an open new-key secret stays put while the connection sorts itself out.
gist.summary: When a dashboard session refresh fails because of a network error or failed get-session call, the dashboard keeps the last confirmed session; expired sessions still sign out, and failures before any confirmed session still show an error.
gist.impact: A transient refresh failure leaves the dashboard and an open new-key secret in place instead of replacing them with an error page.
